messages:
Riley: Quick idea 1: Pub Cup penalty-shootout prophecy jar in the kitchen tomorrow? $1 guesses, winner gets the jar + a free office coffee coupon. :soccer:
Noah: i'm down. is it one guess per person or multiple? also whorings the vuvuzela? :loud_sound:
Jen: one guess each to keep it spicy. putting my money on the keeper to save 2. :crossed_fingers: 
Carlos: can we add a "best goalkeeper face" caption contest to the jar? winner gets the jumper swap. :thinking_face: 
Riley: yes to the caption thing. also, quick note: please label your jerseys if you leave them in the lounge. we had one lonely Napoli back in the dryer for a week. :sweat_smile:
SnackBot: Reminder: free chips in the kitchen today  lasts until 16:00. Please recycle the bag. 
Noah: also proposing a jersey swap table. bring any jersey (clean) and pin a post-it with size and team. trade-off happens at halftime. 
Jen: i'm bringing a vintage 2010 home kit i found in my closet. not sure it's wearable but it's iconic. :heart_eyes:
Carlos: @Jen i'll trade you a 2014 away if you promise not to hang it on the office plant this time. :joy:
Elena: Can someone make a tiny bracket for the penalty guesses? even just a google sheet. i can format it. 
Riley: @Elena pls do. short column: Name | Guess (Player & Minute) | Caption entry. i'll seed with a sample row. 
Noah: sample: Noah | Hernandez @ 90+2 | "keeper did a TikTok move" :rofl: 
Jen: adding my caption: "shot of destiny or the ref's bad angle?" 
Carlos: Heads up 1: there's a small rules note: if the same player is guessed by multiple people, tie goes to earliest submission timestamp. 
SnackBot: Note: kitchen trash pickup at 21:30. If you plan to host snacks after the game, add to calendar: https://calendar.example/events/pub-cup. 
Riley: ok sheet is up: https://sheets.example/pub-cup-penalty-jar. Fill by 18:00 tomorrow. 
Elena: also pinging facilities to borrow 2 folding chairs. @Facilities? 
Jen: if chair request denied, we can do picnic-style on the lobby turf. blankets encouraged. :blanket:
Noah: important question: whorings the elite halftime mixtape? i'm curating. requesting 90s bangers and one pump-up anthem. 
Carlos: i'll bring the speaker and a mini disco light. low key but devastating. :speaker::sparkles: 
Riley: last thing 1: whoever wins the jar has to wear a silly paper crown for the group photo. shame and glory. :crown::camera_with_flash: 
Elena: i'm in for taking the photo. also volunteering as crown maker. 
Noah: perfect. see y'all by the lounge at 19:45. no refunds on bad predictions. :grimacing:
